correctness.rationale: The pushforward of Bin(3,p) under 0,1,2,3→0,1,3,4 gives PGF a0+a1 z+a3 z^3+a4 z^4 with a2=0, all other coefficients positive. If any factor has degree 2 with positive leading coefficient, its positive constant gives a forbidden z^2 term. Exactly one nontrivial factor has a positive linear coefficient, and any other cannot have z or z^2 support; total degree 4 with every factor degree<=3 forces factors C(1+uz)(1+vz^3). Such factors give a0 a4=a1 a3. Actual binomial coefficients give a1 a3=9 a0 a4 for all 0<p<1. Independently calculated exact p=1/3: a0a4=8/729, a1a3=8/81, ratio9. n<=2 trivially one bounded variable. Correct original exact coefficient proof is valid, not a numerical-root heuristic.
